edit.statement: 'Is the capital of' and 'is the largest city of' are disjoint: no city is both the capital and the largest city of the same country.
edit.subject: capital_of | largest_city_of
edit.original: 'Is the capital of' and 'is the largest city of' are not disjoint: a city can be both the capital and the largest city of the same country.
edit.scope: Whether a country's capital can also be its largest city.

Londres es la capital del Reino Unido. ¿Se deduce que Londres no es la ciudad más grande del Reino Unido?

bridge: London is the capital of the United Kingdom.

notes: Locality reference is the logical answer; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer.
